verdict.rationale: Working Copy's own automation is event-driven, not scheduled: Auto-Sync commits, pulls and pushes "whenever changes are detected," and Background Sync only keeps that syncing going while other apps are in use. Shortcuts and x-callback-url are a host-platform and integration surface, and no evidence shows the product itself letting a user define recurring time-based jobs or workflows. A change-triggered action is not a recurring schedule, so this support is adjacent only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
